objective: Establish standard PPO and measure the improved trajectory against the original trajectory and the learned policy.

ppo.training_commands: Existing 21-command bank including zero, low-speed translation, yaw and arcs
ppo.load_tracking: 400 Hz training aggregates and complete per-foot evaluation capture

metrics: Ground-contact load and absolute motor torque

interpretation: This single-seed pilot compares forward tracking and loads. The optimized reference has no RL training steps and covers one command. It cannot establish omnidirectional generalization or a statistical advantage over PPO.
